sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be 
performed on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.

Fuel oil pumps
guarantee oil delivery to the burners for firing through two 
lines one to unit 5, and the other to the unit 6, each line has two fuel oil 
pumps and two heaters.
Technical specification:
Flow rate for Mazout pump = 120 m3/h
Temperature = 120 OC
Pump pressure delivery = 42 bar

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be 
performed on a monthly bases as indicated by M1 in the title block.
Fuel oil pumps
guarantee oil delivery to the burners for firing through two 
lines one to unit 5, and the other to the unit 6, each line has two fuel oil 
pumps and two heaters.
Technical specification:
Flow rate for Mazout pump = 120 m3/h
Temperature = 120 OC
Pump pressure delivery = 42 bar

Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear

Start the standby Mazout pump.

Disconnect the CB of the pump's motor.
Start the standby Mazout pump.
Stop & isolate the pump, and close the valves of the pump.
Disconnect the CB of the pump's motor.
Tools and Equipment
Standard tool set, types of wrenches, rags, funnel,
Mobile oil, Mobile gear 627 for pump gearbox
Grease, Mobile/Mobilux Ep2 / Ep3 for pump bearings
Work to be Carried Out
Clean the pump.
Change oil for pump gear box by opening screen, drain the old oil and fill the 
 housing by a new oil every 750 h.
Grease the pump bearings every 800h.
